# P1 checklist — Intent & proposal DoV

| id | Required | Check | Evidence hints |
|----|----------|-------|----------------|
| P1-1 | yes | Pre-SDD workdir / analysis slots present for the change intent | `requirement-workspace/` (+ analysis/ready as used) |
| P1-2 | yes | Requirements / Pre-SDD req artifacts exist; blocking OQs + DoR BLOCKERs all resolved | outputs of `/sdd:pre-spec-req` |
| P1-3 | yes | Impact analysis brief exists (from embedded `pre-spec-req` or standalone `/sdd:impact-analysis`; or explicit N/A with rationale) | impact artifact path |
| P1-4 | yes | OpenSpec proposal **and/or** story list exists | `openspec/changes/…` and/or story artifacts |
| P1-5 | no | Explore kit run | evidence from `/sdd:explore`; no evidence / not run → Skipped |
| P1-6 | no | Agent evalset | evidence from `/sdd:agent-evalset`; no evidence / not run → Skipped |
